attchmntText: Kohinoor Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the Board Meeting'.
voiceSummary: Kohinoor Foods Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The company has fully discharged its One Time Settlement amount with lenders and obtained No Objection Certificates. A rights issue for up to Rs. 105 crore was approved by the Board on August 13, 2026, but remains subject to regulatory approvals with no proceeds received as of September 30, 2026. The company reported a material uncertainty regarding its ability to continue as a going concern due to accumulated losses and negative net worth, though management considers the going concern basis appropriate based on improved operating performance and the rights issue. An aggregate interest cost of Rs. 145.40 lakh was recognized as an exceptional item regarding a vendor settlement. A SEBI Show Cause Notice is pending, with a settlement application under consideration.

attchmntText: Kohinoor Foods Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kohinoor Foods Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 13, 2026. The company has fully discharged its One Time Settlement amount with lenders and obtained No Objection Certificates. A rights issue for up to Rs. 105 crore was approved on August 13, 2026, but remains subject to regulatory approvals with no proceeds received as of September 30, 2026. The company disclosed an exceptional interest cost of Rs. 145.40 lakh regarding a vendor settlement. Management noted accumulated losses and negative net worth as of September 30, 2025, indicating material uncertainty regarding the going concern assumption, though financial results were prepared on a going concern basis due to improved operating performance and the proposed rights issue. A SEBI Show Cause Notice is pending settlement.
